notes: Official GEO record verified 2026-08-21: MEDITREME trial scRNA-seq arm, 8 samples (PBMC/TIL), same PMID 37563240 as GSE235919. No download performed. Real per-file names/sizes obtained 2026-08-26 via the GEO FTP suppl directory index (filelist.txt itself 404s for this series): GSE235917_5prim_barcodes.tsv.gz (81K), GSE235917_5prim_features.tsv.gz (627K), GSE235917_5prim_matrix.mtx.gz (59M) -- one pooled 10x-style matrix triplet, not split per-sample -- plus 4 VDJ clonotype files, GSE235917_FGSL11_clonotypes.csv.gz (67K), GSE235917_FGSL5_clonotypes.csv.gz (45K), GSE235917_FGSL8_clonotypes.csv.gz (87K), GSE235917_FSGL2_clonotypes.csv.gz (67K). **Corrected 2026-08-26 (round 1 review of PR #88)**: an earlier version of this note interpreted the 8 GSM samples as "4 patients x 2 sites (PBMC+TIL)" -- wrong. Independently re-fetched GEO's own per-GSM sample titles: the 8 GSMs are C1_mRNA_5prime/C1_mRNA_VDJ, C2_mRNA_5prime/C2_mRNA_VDJ, Chir_PBMC_mRNA_5prime/Chir_PBMC_mRNA_VDJ, Chir_Tils_mRNA_5prime/Chir_Tils_mRNA_VDJ -- i.e. 4 biological/timepoint inputs (treatment cycle-1 PBMC, cycle-2 PBMC, surgery PBMC, surgery tumor/TIL), each with a paired 5' mRNA-expression library and a VDJ library, NOT four patients x two sites. The 4 clonotype files are the four VDJ-library outputs, one per timepoint/site input, not one per patient. Note (observed, not corrected): three clonotype files use the prefix "FGSL" and one uses "FSGL" (FSGL2) -- a real naming inconsistency in the source deposit, not a typo introduced here; not resolved further.
